definitions.explanation: The rate at which something moves or operates.

examples.japanese: {速度|そくど}{制限|せいげん}は{時速|じそく}60キロだ。
examples.english: The speed limit is 60 kilometers per hour.

notes:
{速度|そくど} is composed of {速|そく} (fast) + {度|ど} (degree).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {速度|そくど}を{上|あ}げる: to speed up
- {速度|そくど}を{落|お}とす: to slow down
- {速度|そくど}{制限|せいげん}: speed limit
- {平均|へいきん}{速度|そくど}: average speed
- {最高|さいこう}{速度|そくど}: maximum speed

VS. スピード:
- {速度|そくど}: formal/technical term
- スピード: casual/everyday term
